"Nikolaj \"Lord of the Betrayers\" Wendt" <nikolajwendt@gmail.com> wrote:
> All vehicles have this text:
> "A minion may have only 1 vehicle. "

> Can I take actions to get additional vehicles or swap two on one
> minion via for instance Heidelburg?

You can not voluntarily attempt something that would result in an illegal 
state.
Reg Driscoll can't even get a Sport Bike with the intention of giving it away
if he already has one.

Swapping with Heidelberg is probably OK.  They park in the castle parking 
lot and just trade keys.
